2. It is the case of the petitioner that, on 25.07.2024 at about 5.30 p.m., within the jurisdiction of Dobbespet Police Station, near Wildcraft factory, Dabbaspete - Shivagange main road, Honnenahalli Village, Nelamangala Taluk, when the petitioner was riding the unoffending Motor Cycle bearing reg. No. KA-06-ED-3572, at that time the accused drove the offending Motor Cycle bearing reg.
KA-06-HH-0445 drove the same in a high speed, rash and negligent M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 manner so as to endangering human life and dashed against the unoffending Motor Cycle, as a result, the Petitioner fell down on the road and the petitioner as sustained grievous injuries on his right leg and other parts of the body.

Thereafter Petitioner was shifted to Vinayaka Hospital,
Tumkur wherein he was treated as inpatient and he has spent Rs.4,00,000/- towards medical expenditure and other incidental charges.
In this regard the mother of Petitioner/Jagadamba has lodged complaint before the Dobbespet police station.

Accordingly, a case was registered in their Crime No.187/2024 and prepared F.I.R. for the offence punishable under sections 281 and 125(b) of BNS and submitted to the jurisdictional judicial Magistrate and the superior officers and investigation was taken up by the investigating Officer.

Due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident he lost his income and future prospective life,
happiness, and earning capacity and become disabled and dependent.
The M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 alleged accident is occurred due to fault and negligence act of the rider of the offending Motor Cycle bearing Reg. No.KA-06-HH-0445.
Respondent No.1 is the RC.
Owner and Respondent No.2 is the insurer of the said offending vehicle, as such the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to Petitioner.

20. Admittedly, the accused is the driver of the offending vehicle and further admitted that,

The counsel for Respondent No.2 claimed that the said accused to be innocent and further the counsel for Respondent No.2 contended that, the alleged accident occurred due to fault of the Petitioner and no fault of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle, he was driving slowly and therefore he cannot be held to be negligent.

On going through the prosecution papers, FIR, Spot mahazar, Spot Sketch, Wound Certificate and Charge Sheet and the evidence of PW-1 is specific to the effect that, the driver of the offending vehicle/accused is the reason for the said incident and at his instance, the incident took place and the alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle and fault of the accused.

Therefore, considering the above discussed aspects collectively, it is the considered opinion of the Court that, the incident having been taken place in the manner asserted by the prosecution and the same being proved to have been taken place in the manner alleged by the prosecution, the accused drove the offending vehicle in a high speed, rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and at the spot dashed against the unoffending vehicle, as a result Petitioner sustained grievous injuries.
The evidence of Pw.1, Ex.P-1/FIR, Ex.P-2/Complaint, Ex.P3/spot mahazar, Ex.P4/Wound Certificate and Ex.P-8/Charge Sheet clearly establishes that the alleged accident occurred at the spot.

Accordingly I answered Issue No.1 in the Affirmative.
21. Issue No.2 :-

The Learned counsel for the Petitioner has contended that, the injured Petitioner was aged about 37 years and he was an agriculturist and earning Rs.30,000/- p.m., and the Petitioner has incurred heavy expenses towards medical expenditure.

As such the Petitioner is entitled for compensation under the head of pain and suffering, mental agony, medical expenses,
special diet, M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 conveyance, loss of future income due to disability, loss of amenities and loss of income during laid up period and prays to award the compensation as prayed in the petition.

22. On the other hand, the learned counsel for Respondent No.2 insurance company contended that even though the Petitioner claimed that his earning was about Rs.30,000/- p.m., the same is not established by the claimant by producing the documents.
Since the Petitioner has not established his income, he is not entitled for compensation towards such prospects and hence prays dismissal of the petition.

23. The petitioner contended that as on the date of the accident he was aged about 37 years and he relied on the Ex.P.14/Adhar Card of the Petitioner, wherein the date of birth of the Petitioner is shown as 06.04.1987 and this accident was took place on 25.07.2024.
Hence it is clear that as on the date of the accident the Petitioner was aged about 37 years 3 months.
Hence the age of the Petitioner is considered as 37 years.
It is not in dispute that the Petitioner sustained injuries in the road traffic accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle by its driver/accused.
In the instance case the petitioner claimed that he was an agriculturist and earning sum of Rs.30,000/- p.m.
But he has not produced single piece of document to prove his actual income.
In the absence of proof of income the notional income has to be assessed.

As per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority, for the accident taken place in the year 2024, the notional income of the Petitioner is taken at Rs.15,750/-.
25.

In support of his oral evidence, the doctor/PW-3 has produced Ex.P- 23/Clinical report and Ex.P24/X-ray.
In the cross- examination of PW-3 by the counsel for Respondent No.2 he has deposed that, the Petitioner required future treatment.

Further he has denied that without any support the Petitioner can do his work and activities.
Further he has deposed that he has not given estimation letter in relating to expenditure of future treatment.
The fractures are united.

He has assessed physical disability.
Further he denied that in order to help the petitioner he has assessed disability on the higher M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 side and filed false evidence affidavit and deposing falsely.

26. As the occupation of the petitioner is considered as working as agriculturist, while doing his work the petitioner has to stand and sit for long time, he has to bend, put weight on both legs, he has to sit down while doing the work.
But due to injuries sustained in the alleged accident, he is not in a position to do work as earlier.
The doctor stated that the Petitioner has sustained physical disability of the right lower limb at 59% and whole body disability at 20%.

Hence by considering the age,
occupation, nature of injury and the functional disability of the petitioner is considered as 20% to the whole body.
27. With regard to the quantum, age of the petitioner is considered as 37 years and the income is considered at Rs.15,750/- p.m.
As per Sarala Varma's Case the multiplier 15 is applicable and functional disability is considered at 20%.

On considering the avocation and age of the petitioner,
the total loss of future income is calculated as (Rs.15,750/- X 12 X 15 X 20/100) = Rs.5,67,000/-.
Hence, an amount of Rs.5,67,000/- is awarded to the petitioner under M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 the head loss of future income for the disability suffered by him in the accident.

28. In the alleged accident the petitioner has sustained right tibial comminuted fracture and the Petitioner undergone ORIF with LCP on 26.07.2024, which shows that definitely the petitioner has suffered pain due to the injuries sustained in the accident, hence an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is awarded towards pain and suffering, mental agony.
29. Further due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has taken treatment as an inpatient at Hospital for a period from 25.07.2024 to 30.07.2024 i.e., for 6 days.
Therefore this court deems it appropriate to award Rs.30,000/- (Rs.5,000/- per day X 6 days) under head of special diet and conveyance.
30. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has suffered uncomfortable in his day to day life, hence an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is awarded towards loss of amenities.

opennyai_summary.facts:
1. The petitioner filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act 1989, seeking compensation of Rs.20,00,000/- for the injures sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 25.07.2024.
Due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident he lost his income and future prospective life,
happiness, and earning capacity and become disabled and dependent.
The M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 alleged accident is occurred due to fault and negligence act of the rider of the offending Motor Cycle bearing Reg. No.KA-06-HH-0445.
Hence Petitioner filed the present claim petition for seeking compensation.
Further it has contended that the insured vehicle is not involved in the accident.
The insurer liability is subjected to validity of the DL, permit and other documents as per the law.
Further it is denied that the age, income and occupation of the Petitioner and the petition is false and frivolous in the eye of law and the quantum of compensation claimed by the claimants is exorbitant and reserves the right u/s.170 of M.V. Act., and violated terms and conditions of the insurance policy.
opennyai_summary.issue:
:: I S S U E S ::
1.
Whether the Petitioner proves that on 25.07.2024 at about 5.30 p.m., when the Petitioner was riding the unoffending Motor Cycle bearing registration No.KA-06-ED-3572 from Dobbespet towards Magadi near Wild Craft Factory Honnenahalli, Sompura Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk, Bengaluru District, at that time the rider of the offending Motor Cycle bearing registration No.KA-06-HH-0445 M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 drove the same in high speed, in rash and negligent manner and dashed against his unoffending Motor Cycle and due to impact he fell down and sustained grievous injuries?
2. Whether petitioner is entitled for compensation?
If so, what is the quantum?
from whom?
3.
What order or award?
3  :REASONS:
10. Issue No.1:- This petition is filed u/s.166 of M.V.Act 1989 for seeking compensation for the injuries sustained by the Petitioner in the alleged accident.
11.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is contended that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 the rider of the offending vehicle.
The Respondent No.2/Insurance Company admitted that offending vehicle was duly insured with it and its version is that, the alleged accident occurred due to fault of the Petitioner and no fault of the rider of the offending vehicle and therefore he cannot be held to be negligent.
Hence the age of the Petitioner is considered as 37 years.
M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 24.
It is not in dispute that the Petitioner sustained injuries in the road traffic accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle by its driver/accused.
In the instance case the petitioner claimed that he was an agriculturist and earning sum of Rs.30,000/- p.m.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The burden to prove the framed issues lies on the Petitioner.
The accident occurred due to negligent driving of the driver of the offending vehicle.
Petitioner sustained grievous injuries due to alleged accident caused by the offending vehicle in question.
The counsel for Respondent No.2 claimed that the said accused to be innocent and further the counsel for Respondent No.2 contended that, the alleged accident occurred due to fault of the Petitioner and no fault of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle, he was driving slowly and therefore he cannot be held to be negligent.
It seems that Pw.1 has clearly made those versions, which could not be shattered in cross examination.
Therefore, considering the above discussed aspects collectively, it is the considered opinion of the Court that, the incident having been taken place in the manner asserted by the prosecution and the same being proved to have been taken place in the manner alleged by the prosecution, the accused drove the offending vehicle in a high speed, rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and at the spot dashed against the unoffending vehicle, as a result Petitioner sustained grievous injuries.
the accident happened due to rash and negligent act of the accused.
At the same time, it has come out in evidence that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle and fault of the accused.
Matters being so, acts of the accused person clearly constitute the offences punishable under sections 281 and 125(b) of BNS.
Thus because of such negligent act of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle, it resulted in the injuries of the innocent young man/Petitioner aforesaid, as he/accused drove the said offending vehicle very rashly or negligently on the spot.
Therefore, the alleged accident occurred due to the fault of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle.
But he has not produced single piece of document to prove his actual income.
In the absence of proof of income the notional income has to be assessed.
opennyai_summary.decision:
On considering the avocation and age of the petitioner,
the total loss of future income is calculated as (Rs.15,750/- X 12 X 15 X 20/100) = Rs.5,67,000/-.
Hence, an amount of Rs.5,67,000/- is awarded to the petitioner under M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 the head loss of future income for the disability suffered by him in the accident.
29. Further due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has taken treatment as an inpatient at Hospital for a period from 25.07.2024 to 30.07.2024 i.e., for 6 days.
Therefore this court deems it appropriate to award Rs.30,000/- (Rs.5,000/- per day X 6 days) under head of special diet and conveyance.
30. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has suffered uncomfortable in his day to day life, hence an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is awarded towards loss of amenities.
Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the Petitioner would require atleast six months period to recuperate and to get back to his normal day to day activities.
Therefore the Petitioner would be entitled to Rs.94,500/- (Rs.15,750/- x 6 months) under the head loss of income during laid up period.
32. Further the Petitioner has produced hospital and medical bills, towards medical expenses as per Ex.P.11 for an amount of Rs.84,900/-.
Hence the petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.84,900/- under the head of hospital and medical expenses.
33. In the evidence affidavit of PW-3/doctor has stated that the Petitioner needs surgery for removal of implants which would cost around Rs.1,60,000/-.
Hence, the Petitioner is entitled for Rs.1,60,000/- compensation under the head future medical expenses.
The details of compensation I propose to award are as under:
Sl. Compensation under different heads Amount in (Rs) No. 1 Loss of future income due to disability 5,67,000-00 2 Pain and suffering, mental agony 1,00,000-00 3
Special diet and conveyance 30,000-00 4 Loss of amenities 1,00,000-00 5 Loss of income during laid up period 94,500-00 6
Actual medical expenses 84,900-00 7
Future medical expenses 1,60,000-00 Total 11,36,400-00
The Petitioners are entitled to a total compensation of Rs.11,36,400/-.
35.
Hence the respondents No.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay the award amount.
However, the primary liability to pay the compensation amount is fixed on the respondent No.2/Insurance Company and it is directed to deposit the compensation amount.
Thus I conclude that, the Insurance company/Respondent No.2 is directed to M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 deposit the compensation amount along with interest at 6% p.a., from the date of filing of the claim petition.
36. Issue No.3:
In the result I proceed to pass the following: -
ORDER
The claim petition filed by the Petitioner under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act is hereby Partly allowed with cost.
The Petitioner is entitled for  total compensation amount of  Rs.11,36,400/- (Rupees Eleven lakhs Thirty Six thousand and Four hundred only) with interest @ 6% p.a., from the date of petition till its realization.
Amount awarded under the future medical expenses does not carry future interest.
Further, Respondent No.2/ Insurance Company being insurer of the offending vehicle is directed to deposit the compensation amount M.V.C.No.5981/2024 SCCH - 7 together with 6% interest within 60 days from the date of this order.
After deposit, entire compensation amount with interest shall be released in favour of the Petitioner under E-payment with proper verification and identification.
Advocate fee is fixed at  Rs.1,000/-.
Draw the award accordingly.
